findings.detail: Common equity row stored acquisition date 2024-11-14 as maturity_date even though the source maturity-date cell is blank.
Preferred equity row stored acquisition date 2024-09-06 as maturity_date even though the source maturity-date cell is blank.
Preferred equity row stored acquisition date 2024-12-04 as maturity_date even though the source maturity-date cell is blank.
Preferred equity row stored acquisition date 2024-09-27 as maturity_date even though the source maturity-date cell is blank.
Preferred equity row stored acquisition date 2024-12-10 as maturity_date even though the source maturity-date cell is blank.

rationale: X10 fired because extracted maturity_date values precede the 2024-12-31 report date. The SOI rows show the same dates in the Acquisition Date column, while the Maturity Date column is blank for the common equity and preferred equity positions. The correct remediation is to leave maturity_date blank for these rows rather than treating the acquisition date as maturity.
